_doc: Aurora SLO baselines — p95 latency (ms) and max error rate targets. Established at 50 concurrent users, 60s run.

GET /health.notes: Primary health probe — must stay sub-50 ms under all normal load

GET /api/health.notes: Alternate health endpoint — same tight target as /health

POST /memory/retrieve.notes: Core memory read path (AuMemManager). Active-tier retrieval targets sub-ms; p95 budget includes serialization overhead.

POST /memory/create.notes: Memory write path — slightly tighter than retrieve because writes go to active tier first

GET /telemetry/snapshot.notes: R-2 Agent Telemetry snapshot — async aggregation may add latency

GET /metrics.notes: Prometheus scrape endpoint — must be consistently fast for scrape intervals

GET /api/synergy/health.notes: Synergy dashboard health — topology analysis may be moderately expensive

GET /simulate/scenarios.notes: Static list endpoint — should be very fast

POST /simulate/scenario.notes: Full quantum simulation — intentionally wide budget due to async execution and backend variability

GET /api/drift/patterns.notes: Drift detection pattern read — ML inference adds latency

notes: Re-run load tests after significant changes to core paths (memory, quantum, telemetry). Use AuroraHighLoadUser for stress testing at higher concurrency.
